qualitative.moat_explanation: The 10-K excerpt provided consists almost entirely of XBRL taxonomy tags, cover-page data, and boilerplate legal/forward-looking-statement language rather than the actual Business, Risk Factors, or MD&A narrative text. There is no substantive description of Bloom Energy's products, technology, customer relationships, competitive position, or market structure to support any moat classification, so a durable competitive advantage cannot be assessed from what was provided.
red_flags: XBRL tags show revenue and accounts receivable concentration tracked across three named customers (CustomerOne/Two/Three), implying customer concentration risk, though the excerpts contain no actual percentages or narrative context.

Numerous convertible senior notes (multiple tranches maturing 2025 through 2030), secured term loans, and both recourse and non-recourse debt structures appear in the tags, suggesting significant reliance on debt financing, but the excerpts don't provide leverage ratios or repayment risk discussion.
A geographic revenue concentration risk tag for the Asia Pacific region is present, but the excerpts don't quantify how much revenue is concentrated there.

Extensive related-party and joint-venture structures with SK Ecoplant and Brookfield-affiliated entities appear throughout the tags, which could indicate dependence on a small number of strategic partners, though the excerpts don't explain the nature of these arrangements or associated risks.
